definitions.strict: All Trend Template rules pass: price > 50/150/200 SMA, 50 > 150/200, 150 > 200, 200 SMA rising over 20 sessions, price >= 130% of 52-week low, price >= 75% of 52-week high, RS percentile >= 70.
definitions.sepaStyle: Strict Template plus 20-session pivot breakout, volume >= 1.5x prior 50-session average, 10-session range <= 12% and narrower than prior 20-session range, and close within 10% of 40-session high.

limitations: SEPA-style VCP is an objective proxy, not Mark Minervini discretionary chart reading.
Yahoo-adjusted data and corporate-action quality limits remain.
